messages:
Mike (Sales): Heads-up — large enterprise prospect sent a security questionnaire this morning. Highlights: 7y immutable audit logs, per-user export on request, GDPR DSR workflow, and customer-managed KMS. PDF attached. :eyes:
Ashley (PM): Thanks. Quick triage: is this a gating requirement for the deal? timeline? are they requesting this for Hosted or Private?
Mike (Sales): They said must-have for contract. Timeline = Q3 pilot, legal review next 2 weeks. They prefer Hosted but will consider Dedicated if needed. ARR potential high.
Taylor (Security): High-level: 7 years is long but doable. Key concerns: storage cost, immutable tamper-evidence (WORM), separation of audit logs vs customer content, retention policy enforcement, KMS integration for key rotation, and ability to produce tamper-proof export for audits.
Devon (Support): Current product: hosted default retention is 365 days for request logs, exports available via admin API but no built-in WORM mode or long-term cold storage tier. We have a manual DSR playbook but not an automated per-user export with SLA.
Sam (Legal): We need data export format agreed (machine-readable), proof of deletion flow, and DSR SLA. Also want audit evidence of access to logs (who requested exports).
Ashley (PM): OK — to scope this for the backlog we need acceptance criteria, estimated effort, and potential mitigations. I'll propose triage options: (A) Minimal hosted extension: add configurable retention up to 8y + admin export API + DSR checklist (low effort). (B) Enterprise add-on: Dedicated cold-tier + customer-managed KMS + WORM logging + signed attestations (higher effort, special pricing).
Taylor (Security): From risk POV, plan B required for customers insisting on KMS + WORM. Option A should include server-side encryption, access audit trails, and retention config with soft-delete window.
Devon (Support): Implementation notes: export API exists, can extend to include structured audit bundle (logs + metadata). We'll need background job to move older logs to blob cold storage and TTL enforcement.
Ashley (PM): Can someone draft acceptance criteria? I'll start: 1) Admin config UI/API to set retention days per-tenant up to 2920 (8 years). 2) Export endpoint that returns audit logs and access metadata in NDJSON within 48h. 3) DSR workflow doc + playbook and API hook. 4) Option flag for customer-managed KMS (Legal/security gating). 5) Rollout plan and cost estimate.
Mike (Sales): I'll ask customer to choose Hosted vs Dedicated and confirm if KMS is mandatory. Also asking if 48h export SLA is OK or they need 24h.
Sam (Legal): Add requirement: export must include integrity checks (hashes) and retention deletion proof (timestamped deletion logs).
ComplianceBot: New questionnaire "AcmeGlobal_Security_Questions.pdf" uploaded to /shared/compliance/1910000000 by Mike (Sales) at 2026-03-20T09:12Z.
Ashley (PM): Next steps: 1) Taylor/Devon do quick feasibility + rough effort estimate by EOD tomorrow. 2) Mike to confirm timeline + KMS mandate. 3) Sam to list legal minimums for export format and attestations. I'll add a single backlog story with two sub-epics (hosted-extension, enterprise-add-on). If customer mandates KMS+WORM, escalate to SOC2 roadmap bucket.
Taylor (Security): Will do a tech note: KMS integration options (BringYourOwnKey via KMS API vs customer HSM gateway) and WORM implementation patterns (append-only buckets + signed manifests).
Devon (Support): I'll prototype export NDJSON schema and a small script to pull logs into a zipped bundle. Snippet:```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T09:00:00Z",
  "event": "request_received",
  "request_id": "abc123"
}
```
Ashley (PM): Great. Please post estimates in this thread. If effort for full enterprise add-on > 6 wks, we'll negotiate scope with customer (possible compromise: 3y retention + paid cold storage + quarterly attestations).
Mike (Sales): Customer OK to discuss compromise. Will push for 7y but expects pricing concession.
Sam (Legal): Also confirm jurisdictional nuances for GDPR vs local retention laws; 7y might conflict with minimization in some regions. Add legal review item.
Ashley (PM): Summary and owner matrix in a comment: Mike = sales follow-up; Taylor = security feasibility; Devon = export prototype; Sam = legal constraints; Ashley = backlog + rollout plan. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
